purpose: Define how future author, ACM-access, or external-review responses should be normalized, validated, and mapped to the next X-HD reproduction action.

minimum_fields: paper input path or logical workload row
whether input bytes are available locally
supported_response_types.sufficient_to_run_pod_gate: only after at least one matching input file is available or can be regenerated
supported_response_types.sufficient_to_claim_exact_input: not by itself; exact status requires hash verification against bytes or accepted regeneration

supported_response_types.sufficient_to_run_pod_gate: yes, after archive hash is recorded and inputs are extracted under the stated boundary
supported_response_types.sufficient_to_claim_exact_input: only after extracted file hashes are recorded and mapped to paper workloads

supported_response_types.sufficient_to_run_pod_gate: yes, after regeneration output hashes are produced and compared
supported_response_types.sufficient_to_claim_exact_input: only if regenerated outputs match expected paper hashes or external review accepts byte identity

supported_response_types.sufficient_to_run_pod_gate: only if supplement contains usable data, hashes, or regeneration instructions
supported_response_types.sufficient_to_claim_exact_input: not until supplement contents are mapped to paper workloads and verified

supported_response_types.sufficient_to_run_pod_gate: yes, if a bounded matrix under the accepted claim is requested
supported_response_types.sufficient_to_claim_exact_input: only if the verdict explicitly authorizes exact-equivalent wording; otherwise keep Level-B or renamed bounded claim

minimum_fields: whether hashes or regeneration notes are also unavailable
why it does or does not fit known response types

intake_decision_rules.condition: response provides verified author input bytes or archive
intake_decision_rules.next_action: create a new provenance-ingestion goal; record archive/file hashes; run smallest author/RTDL same-input gate on POD

intake_decision_rules.condition: response provides hashes but no bytes
intake_decision_rules.next_action: compare hashes against local/public candidate files if possible; request missing bytes or regeneration path if no match
run regeneration locally or on POD, record output hashes, then run same-input gates

intake_decision_rules.condition: response provides ACM supplement artifact instructions
intake_decision_rules.next_action: ingest supplement listing and artifact instructions; map to paper workloads before any route run

intake_decision_rules.condition: response accepts WaterBodies/BG exact-equivalence with a named boundary
intake_decision_rules.next_action: run the accepted bounded matrix and label it using the accepted claim name, not stronger wording

intake_decision_rules.condition: response rejects exact-equivalence or says artifacts unavailable
intake_decision_rules.next_action: keep full-paper claims blocked and stop at Level-B for the affected scope

privacy_and_repository_boundary.allowed_repo_record: minimal metadata, hashes, permissions, claim boundary, and next-action classification

pod_usage.reason: This is an intake protocol. POD becomes relevant only after a concrete positive response supplies artifacts, regeneration instructions, or accepted reconstruction criteria.

allowed_summary: Goal5329 defines how future author, ACM, or exact-equivalence responses will be normalized and mapped to next actions. It does not claim any response has arrived.
not_allowed: claiming external artifacts have been acquired
claiming ACM supplement has been inspected
